title: BPW-2026-0500
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0500
RELEASE OF STOP NOTICE – SME STEEL CONTRACTORS, INC.
SME Steel Contractors, Inc. is transmitting a Release of Stop Notice in the amount of $47,520,280.41, for furnish and install of structural steel, metal decking, and miscellaneous steel for PCL Construction Services Inc., an apparent subcontractor, in connection with the Los Angeles Convention Center Expansion & Modernization Project. The primary contractor is AEG Plenary Conventions Los Angeles, LLC.
(C-202903, Communication No. 122735 - Filed September 17, 2026)
(REF: BPW-2026-0486)
summary: Release of Stop Notice of $47,520,280.41 from SME Steel Contractors for work on the Los Angeles Convention Center Expansion & Modernization Project.
